description: Large 2D saturating histogram (histo_width x histo_height, 8-bit bins) built by the original Parboil 4-kernel privatized pipeline: prescan (estimate active range) -> intermediates (bin decomposition) -> main (per-block privatized sub-histograms in shared memory with saturating 8-bit atomics) -> final (saturating merge). Faithful port of the Parboil cuda kernels; one pass runs all four kernels, each emitted as its own per-iteration record.

scaling_param.name: img_height
scaling_param.description: Input image height (rows); elements = img_width * img_height. Should be a multiple of 16 (UNROLL).

non_scaling_params.name: img_width
non_scaling_params.description: Input image width (columns); kept equal to histo_width

non_scaling_params.name: histo_height
non_scaling_params.description: Histogram height (bins along y); histo_width*histo_height bins
